description: This file defines the Role class within the OpenMRS project, representing user roles with privileges, inheritance, and hierarchical relationships.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a user role in the OpenMRS system, holding privileges, inherited roles, and child roles, with methods to manage and query role hierarchy and privileges.

methods.name: getPrivileges
methods.description: Returns the set of privileges associated with this role.

methods.name: setPrivileges
methods.description: Sets the privileges for this role.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the role's name.

methods.name: addPrivilege
methods.description: Adds a privilege to the role's privilege set.

methods.name: containsPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if the privilege set contains a privilege with the specified name.

methods.name: removePrivilege
methods.description: Removes a specified privilege from the role.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role's identifier string.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role's identifier string.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if this role contains a privilege with the given name, considering inheritance of superuser.

methods.name: getInheritedRoles
methods.description: Returns roles inherited by this role.

methods.name: setInheritedRoles
methods.description: Sets the roles inherited by this role.

methods.name: inheritsRoles
methods.description: Returns true if this role inherits from other roles.

methods.name: getAllParentRoles
methods.description: Returns all parent roles recursively.

methods.name: recurseOverParents
methods.description: Recursively collects all parent roles, avoiding duplicates and loops.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Unsupported operation, throws exception.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Unsupported operation, throws exception.

methods.name: getChildRoles
methods.description: Returns immediate child roles.

methods.name: setChildRoles
methods.description: Sets immediate child roles.

methods.name: hasChildRoles
methods.description: Checks if the role has any child roles.

methods.name: getAllChildRoles
methods.description: Returns all child roles recursively.

methods.name: recurseOverChildren
methods.description: Recursively collects all child roles, avoiding duplicates and loops.
